blockers.what_was_tried: Read SoundnessStep.lean's modalStepBranch_preserves_sat in full (~500 lines, the K per-step soundness-preservation lemma Soundness.lean's modalExpandBranches_closed_unsat fuel-induction wraps). Confirmed the ambient Kripke model (W, m) never changes throughout that proof -- only the world-assignment function f is pointwise redefined at fresh worlds for the two minting rules (boxNeg/diamondPos) -- so a branchSatisfiableIn FC-generalized version would thread an FC witness through unchanged (structurally low-risk). Neither fits the phase's 1.5-hour budget without unacceptable risk of sorry/shortcuts.

blockers.prohibited_workarounds_confirmed: No sorry, no axiom, no vacuous placeholder introduced. Phases 1-5 preserved green and committed.
